steps.title: Analyze Build Log
steps.description: Inspect the compilation error log to locate the exact syntax issue causing the AAPT2 compiler crash.

steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Verify and validate the app-meta.json file defining 'Hi How To Do' and the namespace 'com.hihowtodo.app'.

steps.title: Clean Build Environment Dependencies
steps.description: Optimize build.gradle by removing unneeded, rule-violating third-party nanohttpd dependencies.

steps.title: Fix Main Layout XML Dimensions
steps.description: Correct the invalid 'match_match' dimension typo on the ScrollView container in activity_main.xml to 'match_parent'.

steps.title: Streamline App Manifest
steps.description: Clean up source AndroidManifest.xml by removing the redundant legacy package attribute and verifying standard namespaces.

steps.title: Verify Custom Drawable Backgrounds
steps.description: Ensure the layout elements point to existing custom resources such as screen and card backgrounds.

steps.title: Verify Button Styles
steps.description: Ensure interactive buttons can correctly render the rounded corner background style.

steps.title: Validate Main Activity Actions
steps.description: Verify MainActivity logic compiles cleanly under strict Java 8 environments with standard view initialization.

steps.title: Verify Manifest & Layout Namespaces
steps.description: Confirm all XML layout schemas match official Android resources guidelines.

steps.title: Building Hi How To Do
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build the final premium Android executable.
